name: Confetti burst
description: Animates the subject to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti.

prompt.default: The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. High-speed studio cinematography, physically accurate reflections and particle motion, locked camera.
prompt.kling: The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Physically accurate motion, steady locked camera.
prompt.seedance: Locked camera, one continuous shot. The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Physically accurate motion.
prompt.veo: The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Cinematic lighting, realistic physics, locked camera.
prompt.wan: The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Locked camera, smooth realistic motion, high detail.
prompt.local-wan: The subject suddenly bursts outward into colorful paper confetti. Individual pieces spin, flutter and fall slowly through the space where the subject stood.
